description: Use this when the domain the user wants is taken (or they ask for other options for a name). Given a full domain like "acme.com", proposes other endings (acme.io), added words (getacme.com), domain hacks and related words, checks every candidate live, and returns only the ones that are not taken. Slower than a single check (up to ~30 live lookups). Also use it when the user describes what the domain is for ("a fitness app in brazil", "a scratch site for side projects"): pass that as brief, with their name as domain if they have one. It then answers like the tld.expert search box: endings that fit the project (each with why and its source page), the popular endings, and name variants, every one checked live, taken ones counted but not listed.

brief.description: Optional: a few words on what the domain is for, e.g. "fitness app in brazil" or "notes beside the main road". Switches to brief mode.

domain.description: The full domain the user wanted, e.g. "acme.com" or "stripe.io". With brief, a bare name like "acme" also works. Required unless brief is given.

name: suggest_tld_alternatives
title: Suggest alternative domains
